lines.zh: 铁靴踏地，三步一停，很稳。
lines.en: Iron boots strike the ground, three steps, a pause.

lines.zh: 刀背擦过石墙，火星往下掉。
lines.en: My blade's back scrapes stone, throwing sparks down.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为从不追人。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I never chase.

lines.zh: 军团的鼓点在前面，我跟着。
lines.en: The legion drums ahead; I follow the beat.

lines.zh: 每块石板都被我踩出裂。
lines.en: Every flagstone cracks under my tread.

lines.zh: 甲片相碰，声音像远处的钟。
lines.en: My plates knock together like distant bells.

lines.zh: 走过焦土，灰在我身后落下。
lines.en: Crossing scorched earth, ash settles behind me.

lines.zh: 我不看路，我看还有多远。
lines.en: I don't watch the road; I watch the distance.

lines.zh: 斩魂的刀，拖在地上不会钝。
lines.en: A soul-cutting blade doesn't dull by dragging.

lines.zh: 队列只剩我一个，队形没变。
lines.en: Only I remain in the file, but the formation holds.

lines.zh: 夜里的风推我，推不动。
lines.en: The night wind pushes me and fails.

lines.zh: 我朝有光的地方走，去收人。
lines.en: I walk toward light, to collect what lives there.

lines.zh: 刀刃朝下，我一寸一寸地挪。
lines.en: Blade pointing down, I shift an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过很多次，都是夜。
lines.en: I have walked this road often, always at night.

lines.zh: 我按着刀柄走，指节一直在响。
lines.en: I walk with a hand on the hilt, knuckles creaking.

lines.zh: 雪地上我的脚印很深，也不乱。
lines.en: My prints in the snow are deep and even.

lines.zh: 铠甲里面，没有可以腐烂的东西。
lines.en: Inside this armor there is nothing left to rot.

lines.zh: 我把刀立在脚边，等号令。
lines.en: I plant the blade at my feet, awaiting orders.

lines.zh: 不朽之骨在体内响了一下。
lines.en: The immortal bone inside me clicks once.

lines.zh: 军团不休息，我只是停下。
lines.en: The legion does not rest; I merely halt.

lines.zh: 我不想家，家早被烧平了。
lines.en: I don't miss home; home was burned flat.

lines.zh: 磨刀不用水，用沙。
lines.en: I sharpen the blade with sand, not water.

lines.zh: 有只乌鸦落在我的刀上。
lines.en: A crow has landed on my blade.

lines.zh: 我数着营火，一共七堆。
lines.en: I count the campfires: seven of them.

lines.zh: 甲缝里长不出草。
lines.en: No grass grows in the seams of my armor.

lines.zh: 我记不清自己的名字了。
lines.en: I can no longer recall my own name.

lines.zh: 风从盔缝钻进来，是凉的。
lines.en: Wind slips through the visor; it is cold.

lines.zh: 刀上有一道旧缺口，我不补。
lines.en: There is an old notch in my blade; I leave it.

lines.zh: 远处的火把晃，我数了三遍。
lines.en: A torch flickers far off; I counted it thrice.

lines.zh: 我睡着了也不会倒下。
lines.en: Even asleep, I do not fall over.

lines.zh: 我把刀插进土里，靠着它站。
lines.en: I plant the blade in the soil and lean on it.

lines.zh: 甲上的血痕我不擦，留着数日子。
lines.en: I leave the bloodstains on my plate to count the days.

lines.zh: 你站得笔直，是块好料。
lines.en: You stand straight; you are good material.

lines.zh: 你的魂很亮，说明还没被砍过。
lines.en: Your soul is bright; it has never been cut.

lines.zh: 摘下面甲，我要看你的眼睛。
lines.en: Lower the visor; I want your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身上有伤，我不占这个便宜。
lines.en: You are wounded; I won't take that advantage.

lines.zh: 你也穿甲，谁的铁匠打的？
lines.en: You wear armor too; which smith made it?

lines.zh: 我认得这种站姿，是练过的。
lines.en: I know that stance; it has been trained.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，刀却握得很紧。
lines.en: Your hands shake, yet you grip the blade tightly.

lines.zh: 抬头。我不砍低头的人。
lines.en: Look up. I do not cut those who bow.

lines.zh: 魂的重量，我一眼就能估。
lines.en: I can weigh a soul at a glance.

lines.zh: 你身后没人，这很公平。
lines.en: No one stands behind you; that is fair.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛，总是先看刀。
lines.en: Living eyes always look at the blade first.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我待会儿再问。
lines.en: I will ask your name afterward.

lines.zh: 甲片裂了，我照样抬手。
lines.en: A plate cracked; I still raise my arm.

lines.zh: 你砍中骨头，刀弹开了。
lines.en: You struck the bone, and your blade bounced.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我旧伤上。
lines.en: That landed on an old wound of mine.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，就一步。
lines.en: I took one step back, only one.

lines.zh: 不朽之骨不会断，只会响。
lines.en: The immortal bone doesn't break, it rings.

lines.zh: 面甲歪了，我扶正它。
lines.en: My visor tilted; I set it straight.

lines.zh: 你的刀很有分量，我记住了。
lines.en: Your blade has weight; I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 膝盖被砍中，我单腿跪下。
lines.en: Struck at the knee, I kneel on one leg.

lines.zh: 血早干了，流不出来。
lines.en: The blood dried long ago; none comes out.

lines.zh: 我把刀插进地里撑住自己。
lines.en: I drive the blade into the ground to steady myself.

lines.zh: 你的魂响得很沉，我听见了。
lines.en: Your soul rings heavy; I hear it.

lines.zh: 亮一点，再亮一点，别熄。
lines.en: Brighter, a little brighter; don't go out.

lines.zh: 军团在后面催，我只好过来。
lines.en: The legion presses behind me; so I come.

lines.zh: 强者的魂，值得走这一趟。
lines.en: A strong soul is worth the walk.

lines.zh: 你把剑举起来，我就有兴趣了。
lines.en: Raise that sword, and I am interested.

lines.zh: 我不收弱的，收回去也压不住。
lines.en: I don't take weak ones; they won't hold the weight.

lines.zh: 那口钟一响，我就想去收人。
lines.en: When that bell rings, I want to collect.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，魂就看不清了。
lines.en: Hold the torch higher and your soul blurs.

lines.zh: 我闻得到不甘心的味道。
lines.en: I can smell unwillingness on you.

lines.zh: 再多站一会儿，让我看够。
lines.en: Stand a while longer; let me look my fill.

lines.zh: 你的甲不错，魂也不错。
lines.en: Your armor is good, and so is your soul.

lines.zh: 别退，退了我就不追。
lines.en: Don't retreat; if you do, I won't follow.

lines.zh: 我等着你自己走过来。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to walk over.

lines.zh: 有人许了我一场好仗。
lines.en: Someone promised me a good fight.

lines.zh: 你的魂比你的甲响得更大。
lines.en: Your soul rings louder than your armour.

lines.zh: 我往前挪半步，已经算给你面子。
lines.en: I shift half a step forward. That is a courtesy.

lines.zh: 撞上盾牌，我退半步。
lines.en: I hit a shield and give half a step.

lines.zh: 甲片刮过你的肩，声音很响。
lines.en: My plate scrapes your shoulder, loudly.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，刀会自己动。
lines.en: Don't stand so close; the blade moves on its own.

lines.zh: 你推我，我像一堵墙。
lines.en: You push me; I am a wall.

lines.zh: 两副甲撞在一起，火花四散。
lines.en: Two sets of armor clash, scattering sparks.

lines.zh: 我撞开门，门轴飞了出去。
lines.en: I walk through the door; its hinge flies off.

lines.zh: 牛车挡路，我把它推开。
lines.en: A cart blocked me; I pushed it aside.

lines.zh: 你从我肋下钻过去，算你灵巧。
lines.en: You slipped under my ribs; call that nimble.

lines.zh: 我踩碎了脚下的砖。
lines.en: I crushed the brick beneath my boot.

lines.zh: 撞到石像，石像倒了。
lines.en: I bumped a statue, and it toppled.

lines.zh: 军团里没有夫妻，只有队列。
lines.en: The legion has no spouses, only ranks.

lines.zh: 我是被铸出来的，不是生出来的。
lines.en: I was forged, not born.

lines.zh: 同袍并肩站着，谁也不说话。
lines.en: Comrades stand shoulder to shoulder in silence.

lines.zh: 斩魂者的后代，是下一批甲。
lines.en: An executioner's offspring is the next batch of armor.

lines.zh: 我不找人成家，我找旗。
lines.en: I don't seek a household; I seek a banner.

lines.zh: 那个位置空着，原本是我的兄弟。
lines.en: That place stands empty; my brother held it.

lines.zh: 我们不合葬，名字刻在同一块铁上。
lines.en: We aren't buried together; our names share one iron plate.

lines.zh: 有人递给我酒，我没喝。
lines.en: Someone handed me wine; I didn't drink.

lines.zh: 誓言比婚礼结实。
lines.en: An oath outlasts any wedding.

lines.zh: 我的伴当早就被砍穿了。
lines.en: My companion was cut through long ago.

lines.zh: 这块铁，能从甲上补个洞。
lines.en: This iron could patch a hole in my armor.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的碎片，收好。
lines.en: I gather my own fragments and stow them.

lines.zh: 地上的骨头，我认得是谁的。
lines.en: I know whose bone that is on the ground.

lines.zh: 弯腰时甲会响，很吵。
lines.en: My armor creaks when I bend, loudly.

lines.zh: 我捡刀不捡钱。
lines.en: I pick up blades, not coins.

lines.zh: 有人掉了盾，我替他收着。
lines.en: Someone dropped a shield; I keep it for them.

lines.zh: 这截链子还能用上。
lines.en: This length of chain is still usable.

lines.zh: 我把碎片按大小排好。
lines.en: I sort the fragments by size.

lines.zh: 捡东西要屈膝，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Picking things up requires kneeling; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 那块破布，擦刀正好。
lines.en: That scrap of cloth will clean my blade.

lines.zh: 你举刀了，那就按规矩来。
lines.en: You raised your blade; then we follow the rules.

lines.zh: 我挑最前面那个。
lines.en: I choose the one in front.

lines.zh: 号角响过，你就是我的了。
lines.en: The horn sounded; you are mine now.

lines.zh: 魂在动，位置定了。
lines.en: The soul moved; its place is fixed.

lines.zh: 你挡住了路，这就是理由。
lines.en: You blocked the road; that is reason enough.

lines.zh: 别躲到人群里，我会数。
lines.en: Don't hide in the crowd; I count everyone.

lines.zh: 我的刀自己抬起来了。
lines.en: My blade has lifted by itself.

lines.zh: 今天只收一个，你运气不好。
lines.en: Only one is taken today; bad luck for you.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，位置刚好。
lines.en: You backed into the corner; the spot is right.

lines.zh: 我看见你的脚步慢了半拍。
lines.en: I saw your step fall half a beat late.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我只跟到你停下。
lines.en: I don't run; I follow until you stop.

lines.zh: 铁靴声一直在你后面。
lines.en: Iron boots keep sounding behind you.

lines.zh: 你翻过山脊，我照旧走。
lines.en: You crossed the ridge; I walk on regardless.

lines.zh: 把门关上没用，我拆门。
lines.en: Closing the door won't help; I remove doors.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不远。
lines.en: Your torch doesn't reach far.

lines.zh: 你走一路，我数一路的痕。
lines.en: You walk; I count every mark along the way.

lines.zh: 前面没桥，你会回头。
lines.en: No bridge ahead; you will turn back.

lines.zh: 军团在前面等，我押着你走。
lines.en: The legion waits ahead; I herd you toward it.

lines.zh: 你喘得越重，我越确定。
lines.en: The harder you breathe, the surer I am.

lines.zh: 追到城的尽头，我就停。
lines.en: I stop at the far end of the city.

lines.zh: 一刀下来，你的盾凹了。
lines.en: One cut, and your shield is dented.

lines.zh: 我砍的是魂，不是肉。
lines.en: I cut the soul, not the flesh.

lines.zh: 刀落偏了半寸，你还能站。
lines.en: The blade fell half an inch off; you still stand.

lines.zh: 这一击我留了力。
lines.en: I held back some force on this blow.

lines.zh: 甲缝是你的弱点，我看见了。
lines.en: The armor seam is your weakness; I see it.

lines.zh: 你挡得住刀，挡不住重量。
lines.en: You block the blade, not the weight.

lines.zh: 刀背砸下去，石头裂开。
lines.en: The blade's back slams down; stone splits.

lines.zh: 你的手麻了，刀掉了。
lines.en: Your hands went numb; the blade fell.

lines.zh: 我收刀，你还站着，那就再来。
lines.en: I withdraw the blade; you stand, so again.

lines.zh: 这一刀之后，魂就轻了。
lines.en: After this cut, the soul grows light.

lines.zh: 号角响过三次，我站在这里。
lines.en: The horn sounded thrice; I stand here.

lines.zh: 我从铁堆里把自己拔出来。
lines.en: I pulled myself out of the iron heap.

lines.zh: 甲上的旧血早干了。
lines.en: The old blood on my armor dried long ago.

lines.zh: 这是第几场仗，我不记得。
lines.en: I don't recall which battle this is.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，面甲自己合上。
lines.en: I lift my head; the visor closes itself.

lines.zh: 军团缺一个人，我补了进来。
lines.en: The legion lacked one; I filled the gap.

lines.zh: 脚下的土是新的，刚翻过。
lines.en: The soil below is new, just turned.

lines.zh: 刀从地里出来时带着土。
lines.en: The blade came out of the earth with soil.

lines.zh: 我看见旗，就走过去了。
lines.en: I saw the banner and walked to it.

lines.zh: 夜很长，够我砍完这一批。
lines.en: The night is long enough to finish this batch.

lines.zh: 火烤着甲，铁开始烫。
lines.en: Fire bakes my armor; the iron grows hot.

lines.zh: 从高处落地，甲片散了一地。
lines.en: I hit the ground hard; plates scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进面甲，我不喊。
lines.en: Water pours into my visor; I don't shout.

lines.zh: 炸开的甲片划破了我自己的脸。
lines.en: Blast fragments cut my own face.

lines.zh: 箭插在甲上，像一根针。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my armor like a pin.

lines.zh: 法术让我僵住一瞬。
lines.en: The spell holds me still for a moment.

lines.zh: 饿对我早就没意义了。
lines.en: Hunger has meant nothing to me for ages.

lines.zh: 雷顺着刀流下来，我握紧了。
lines.en: Lightning runs down the blade; I grip tighter.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，甲还在往下沉。
lines.en: The ground is gone; my armor keeps sinking.
